title: The Gilded Reach
description: The golden meadow: gold turf, teal water, giant Lumineshrooms, and the Eclipse's star overhead.

title: Nebula Fields
description: Violet Chorus Moss plains, and low gravity.

title: Ashen Barrens
description: The leviathan graveyard: pale stone and old bones.

title: Hollow Isles
description: The End's only forest: dim Nullwood on ring-shaped islands.

title: The Leviathan
description: A Star Leviathan's skeleton, some 370 blocks long, adrift over the void, with a purpur citadel along its spine.

title: Its heart
description: In the Leviathan's ribcage, its crimson heart still beats.

title: The Reliquary
description: The ribcage cathedral, its End Chimes pylons and a floor open to the void.

title: Drift Whale
description: A Drift Whale over the Ashen Barrens. Sing one a song and it's yours to ride.

title: Hushback
description: A clear-hided grazer of the Eclipse; hurt one and the herd blinks away.

title: Hydragrip
description: A dark newt lit with cyan; it hunts endermites by the water and coughs up their pearls.

title: Mirror Wretch
description: A worm with a round toothed mouth that slithers low, rears up to strike, and throws familiar sounds from the void's edge to lure you over.

title: The Watcher
description: Only ever seen from the corner of your eye. Look straight at it and it teleports away, to turn up further on toward the Leviathan.
